title: Dallas Wings Connect at Kendrick Lamar Concert Before 2025 Season Kickoff
htmlContent:
The Dallas Wings recently celebrated their team bonding in a luxurious suite at the iconic AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas, by taking a break from preseason training camp. The occasion? Kendrick Lamar and SZA performed together on the Grand National Tour over the weekend. As the 2025 WNBA season approaches, the concert was the perfect moment for the Wings to unwind, connect, and build chemistry off the court. The evening was not just about the electrifying performances of two of the most popular artists in hip-hop and R&B, but also about the overall experience.
It was the chance for the Wings roster, including standout rookie Paige Bueckers, Arike Ogunbowale, Maddy Siegrist, and DiJonai Carrington, to enjoy time together in a relaxed and energetic atmosphere.
"Yeah, it was very fun, just getting to be around each other as a team, hanging out, and doing some cool stuff. I'm a big Kendrick and SZA fan, so that concert was obviously great," said Bueckers, who was the No. 1 overall pick in the 2025 WNBA Draft.
The former UConn superstar has quickly become one of the most anticipated newcomers to the league, adding both elite talent and star power to Dallas. The Wings' front office is committed to creating a strong, cohesive culture, and this concert outing is a significant way to strengthen the team's chemistry. The suite experience at AT&T Stadium offered players a chance to bond in comfort while soaking up world-class entertainment, building relationships that can prove invaluable during the grind of a long WNBA season.
GM Curt Miller on the Dallas Wings:
"The competition that's going to start from Day 1 will be incredible for the Wings. … [I] can't wait to support the coaching staff on the style of play. The exciting belief is that there's so much unselfishness now in the locker room. … When we say foundational, there's still no limits on what this group can do." "It all started with people and strong character in the locker room...the competition that's going to start from Day 1 will be incredible for the Wings...can't wait to support the coaching staff on the style of play...the exciting belief that there's so much unselfishness now in the locker room...when we say foundational, there's still no limits on what this group can do."
It was perfect timing. The Wings are preparing for their season opening against the Minnesota Lynx at College Park Center in Arlington on May 16, 2025. The season has started well for the organization, with the sale of season ticket memberships for the second consecutive year. Fans are eager to witness the talented group's abilities.
The Dallas Wings' off-court camaraderie is a key factor in their on-court success, especially with young players like Bueckers leading the way. The Dallas Wings are setting the tone early because they have a strong culture already in place. The Wings are confident, united, and powerful, as exemplified by the music of Kendrick and SZA and the buzz surrounding a new era of Dallas basketball.
